Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: sharpen.

**What the vignettes add.** The vignettes give the cause and the wanted state: agents bypass the flow ('Agents should not simply bypass the flow'), so 'the flow process needs to be obvious and default', 'a standard core process that is the default that pushes work through the same flow', work 'safely in the flow and then we can push it', and 'we must continue this work until we know that we are following our process'. The process should run the actual work 'whenever possible'.

**Proposed.** Most real work bypasses the agreed process, because the flow is not the obvious default and agents can simply go around it. Work needs to enter through one standard flow, so the process governs what actually happens.

**Depth.** 7 vignettes (4 retell, 3 touch); steady recurrence of the same demand. Dates not checked here.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
